column1: # What to record when the instance is served under a context path.
# These are a separate run and a separate file because the recorder stores
# req.URL.Path verbatim. Under CONTEXT_PATH=/jira every path in every cassette
# gains the prefix, so recording the root manifest here would rewrite all
# twenty-one root recordings into a different deployment shape without saying
# so. record.sh refuses each manifest against the wrong instance.
# Data Center is often served under a context path and none of this project's
# fixtures carried one. Three defects came out of that shape — Relative
# returning before the host check, the prefix applied twice, and /jiraxyz
# reading as inside /jira — and all three were argued from documentation and
# fixed without ever being observed. These recordings are the observation.
# The commands assume the seed: project ENG, board 1, an attachment on ENG-4.
